output.headline: Fixed-price milestones billed twice, too early, or missed at period end

what_keeps_breaking.point: A milestone is billed more than once: it was not marked as billed after finalising, so the next month's proposal billed it again.
A milestone is also billed twice when two open proposals for the same project each pick it up and both are finalised.
Milestones not yet complete were billed once their planned date had passed, a behaviour carried over from 4.0.
Mark complete stamped the system date rather than the business date, so a milestone completed during a late period run fell after the period end and was left out.
The Projects list showed logged hours as unbilled on fixed-price projects, although those projects bill milestones, not hours.

output.why_it_escapes: Only one automated test exists for BR-11 (only completed milestones are billed), and the material does not show whether it covers the planned-date case; none of the fixes added an automated test, with four only updating a manual case and BILL-1153 adding nothing. Repeat billing across runs, concurrent proposals, business-date handling and the Projects list are therefore untested end to end.

proposed_tests.title: Milestone billed in one month is not billed again the next
proposed_tests.scenario: On P-1080, bill the completed milestone Solution design in January and finalise, then create the February proposal; expect no milestone line for Solution design, and the milestone records the January invoice.

proposed_tests.title: Second open proposal for the same project is refused
proposed_tests.scenario: Create a December proposal for P-1080 with a completed milestone, then try to create another before finalising the first; expect refusal with 'Project P-1080 already has an open proposal. Finalise or delete it first.' and the milestone on one proposal only.

proposed_tests.title: Incomplete milestone past its planned date is not billed
proposed_tests.scenario: On P-1080, leave a milestone planned for 15 June incomplete and create the June proposal; expect no line for that milestone.

proposed_tests.title: Milestone completed during a late run uses the business date
proposed_tests.scenario: With the business date set to 31 May and the system date 3 June, mark a P-1080 milestone complete and create the May proposal; expect completion dated 31 May and the milestone billed on the May proposal.

proposed_tests.title: Fixed-price projects show zero unbilled hours on the Projects list
proposed_tests.scenario: Log hours against fixed-price P-1080 and open Projects; expect 0.00 unbilled hours for P-1080, while a time-based project with logged hours still shows them.
